result.summary: The page largely renders correctly for a food delivery app. Found a couple of minor styling inconsistencies, primarily in the favorite icons and bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled inconsistently. The Tokumaru Ramen card shows a plain white heart outline, while the pizza card below shows a heart inside a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent background/container treatment to all favorite icons across cards.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar appears visually cluttered, with the search magnifier and bookmark icons overlapping a horizontal divider line, making the icons hard to distinguish.
issues.suggestion: Ensure navigation icons are clearly separated from the divider line and aligned consistently with proper spacing.
